page.title: Roles & permissions
page.description: Define your school's roles and assign them to your staff.

assignment.searchHint: By surname, nickname, email or ID.

permissions.children:archive: Activate or deactivate a child's record
permissions.parents:write: Create, edit and reset parent accounts
permissions.staff:write: Create, edit and reset staff accounts
permissions.attendance:qrcode: Generate and print attendance QR badges
permissions.attendance:correct: Correct a check-in and ask absent children's parents
permissions.attendance:write: Configure attendance settings (schedules, exemptions, time zone)
permissions.gallery:read: View the media gallery (photos and videos from reports)
permissions.menus:read: View the week's menu and past menus
permissions.menus:write: Create and edit weekly menus, and view past menus
permissions.blog:write: Write, publish, edit and delete news items on the public site
permissions.library:read: View the library catalogue and lending records
permissions.library:write: Create, edit and remove books from the catalogue
permissions.library:lend: Record library loans, returns and reminders

roleNameHint: E.g. Head teacher, Deputy head… The rights granted apply to every staff member holding this role.
rolesEmpty: Create roles to grant fine-grained rights to your staff (e.g. Head teacher, Secretary).
